title: Cost bound for deterministic trees
statement: Let the input alphabet be finite and nonempty, and let $T$ be a deterministic decision tree that computes $f$. Regard $T$ as a randomized decision tree with a single deterministic choice. Its worst-case expected number of queries is at most the depth of $T$.
